profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Senior Information Technology professional with progressive responsibilities in retail, manufacturing, healthcare, telecommunications, insurance, banking and professional services environments providing technical analysis, development and support expertise, combining broad information systems knowledge, business acumen, and communication and mentoring skills to plan, implement and develop, support and manage business systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Support and enhancement of a Third Party (Benefit) Administration contribution accounting system on the OpenVMS platform. Efforts include extract, transformation and load of eligibility data for Data Warehouse consumption, creation of a web interface for passage of Employer Remittance data, creation and transmission of EDI X12 834 (Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance) files and development of custom interfaces to provide for required governmental reporting. All applications were developed using OpenVMS/VSI Cobol, OpenVMS/VSI Basic, RMS, DECForms and SQL.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Provided OpenVMS Cobol interface development consulting services to a leading national uniform sales and rental organization (Aramark). Efforts included development of data synchronization interfaces between the Order Management (MCBA-OpenVMS) and Warehouse Management/Inventory Control (WMOS-Linux) systems. Interfaces developed included the transformation of Advanced Shipping Notice data (EDI X12 856 ASN) to flat files for subsequent transmission to the WMOS Warehouse Management application. Additionally provided Cobol embedded SQL code analysis for the functional decomposition of an Employee Incentive compensation application.

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of the VMS application support team, provided development, enhancement, support, and troubleshooting of multiple mortgage insurance OpenVMS Cobol, C and Java based applications and interfaces using, and mapping (DECEDI Translator), EDI X12 transaction sets (872, 260, 263 & 266).   In addition, provided support and enhancement to business critical Mortgage Origination and Servicing applications. Efforts entail utilization of Java (using Eclipse IDE & IntelliJ), Agile (Rally) & Waterfall methodologies, Cobol, C, DECEDI, RMS, OracleRdb, DEC/BEA Message Q, FMS, DECForms, HTML, XML and DCL.

Additionally, as part of the Data Migration team developed OpenVMS Cobol programs to parse RMS flat files for creation of interface files (Extract and Transform) for migration to an MS Sql Server database (Load), for the Corporate Modernization migration effort to a new platform (Guidewire).

positions.title: Consultant
positions.locationName: NJ, NY, DE and PA areas
positions.description:
Provided a full spectrum of consulting services in various roles including Project Management, Team Lead, Senior Programmer/Analyst, EDI X12 (Gentran Translator) and Production Support.  Specific expertise on the OpenVMS and Windows platforms, with additional experience in the Unix environment.  Application development experience includes OpenVMS Cobol, OpenVMS Basic, OpenVMS Fortran, OpenVMS C, Java, Visual Basic 6, PLSQL, embedded SQL and HTML. EDI X12 experience includes familiarity with, and mapping of, 872,260,263,266 (Mortgage Industry) and 940, 945, 810 and 850 (Manufacturing Industry) trading partner transaction sets.

Clients included Fleer/Skybox (Professional sports trading cards), Cigna/Intracorp (Medical and Disability insurance management), Verizon (Telecommunications), Verizon Wireless (Telecommunications), Societe Generale (Banking), Accenture (Consulting), E.I. Dupont (Chemicals), Wawa, Inc.(Retail convenience stores) and Delaware Valley Financial Services (Variable Annuity & Life Insurance administrative services).
